positions.name: Tien Phong Commercial Joint Stock Bank
No Va Land Investment Group Corp
Vietnam Construction and Import Export JSC
Nam A Commercial Joint Stock Bank Ordinary Shares
Dat Xanh Real Estate Service Contructions Corp
Ho Chi Minh City Securities Corp
Investment and Industrial Development Joint Stock Corp

config:
asset_classes:
- equity
equity:
  market: VN
  factor: core_opt
  neutral: neutral
  weighting: dollar
  tier: 3
  shortable: false
universe_filters:
- type: HistoryFilter
  params:
    min_days: 252
- type: DataIntegrityFilter
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: adv_usd
    min_value: 1000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: raw_close
    min_value: 1000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: mcap_usd
    min_value: 50000000.0
    exit_ratio: 0.8
    lag: 1
- type: TradedDaysFilter
  params:
    min_share: 0.9
    lookback: 63
- type: OneClassPerIssuer
- type: ShortableFilter
  params:
    mode: passthrough
- type: PanelFloorFilter
  params:
    panel: universe_member
    min_value: 0.5
    exit_ratio: 1.0
    lag: 0
vol_normalizer:
  type: Identity
signals:
- type: CrossSectionalSignal
  weight: 1.0
  params:
    indicator:
      type: PanelCharacteristic
      params:
        panel: core_opt_w
    ranker:
      type: GroupNeutralRank
      params:
        inner:
          type: PercentileRank
          params:
            min_names: 5
        min_group_size: 5
        min_names: 25
        pool_per_date: true
    position_function:
      type: PanelWeightPortfolio
      params:
        panel: core_opt_w
asset_allocator:
  type: Identity
model_gearing:
  type: XSVolTarget
  params:
    target_vol: 0.1
    vol_lookback: 126
    leverage_cap: 5.0
    buffer: 0.1
    min_gross: 0.2
cost_model:
  type: EquityCosts
  params:
    market: VN
rebalance: daily
position_smoothing: 5
smoothing_method: sma
group_level: sector
